CWPP.definition: Workload-centric security protection technology providing runtime behavioral monitoring, anomaly detection, and vulnerability shielding across container hosts and instances.

CSPM.definition: Continuous automated compliance verification and security configuration auditing against cloud and container infrastructure baselines.

Detection_as_Code.definition: Standard engineering practice of defining, version-controlling, testing, and automating cybersecurity detection rules as code artifacts.

P0_Baseline.definition: Mandatory foundational telemetry logs required for forensic reconstruction, incident traceability, and baseline regulatory compliance.

P1_Baseline.term: P1: High Threat Defense & Hardening Level
P1_Baseline.definition: High-priority runtime container behavioral detection and configuration controls targeting direct exploitation techniques.

P2_Baseline.term: P2: Medium Environmental Adaptive Defense Level
P2_Baseline.definition: Contextual behavioral tuning, advanced anomaly baselining, and automated response orchestration for container workloads.

P3_Baseline.term: P3: Low Operational Observability & Collaboration Level
P3_Baseline.definition: Telemetry aggregation, cross-platform SIEM rule correlation, and continuous operational posture reporting.

MITRE_ATTACK_Containers.definition: Matrix of 36 tactical techniques (TTPs) mapping real-world adversary behavior across containerized orchestrators, runtimes, and cloud hosts.
